candidates.summary: past the cap the preview comment drops directly changed realms while stating they are always kept, and still links them
candidates.failure_scenario: A PR that edits 30 realms under examples/gno.land/r/ (a sweep over examples is the ordinary shape). pr-preview.yml never passes -max-realms, so BuildPlan runs at defaultMaxRealms=25: plan.go:253-259 stable-sorts changed-first, truncates to 25 and sets Dropped=5, so 5 directly changed realms are never rendered. comment.go:60-64 then still lists all 30 under **Changed realms (30)** with links into the snapshot, and comment.go:86 prints 'the changed realms are always kept'. The author reads a comment asserting every realm they touched was previewed and clicks 5 links that 404 in the published snapshot.

candidates.summary: the table reads maxRealms 0 as "use the default", the same value the tool documents as "no cap", so the uncapped path cannot be tested from this table
candidates.failure_scenario: main.go:63 documents -max-realms "0 for no cap" and plan.go:256 implements it as if maxRealms > 0. The table's zero value is consumed as the default at plan_test.go:133-135, so no case ever reaches BuildPlan with 0. Flipping plan.go:256 to if maxRealms >= 0 - which would truncate every realm away under -max-realms 0 - leaves the suite green.
candidates.verify_by: change plan.go:256 to `if maxRealms >= 0 && len(realms) > maxRealms` and run go test ./... in misc/gnopreview; expect green
candidates.evidence: plan_test.go:132-135 `limit := tc.maxRealms; if limit == 0 { limit = defaultMaxRealms }`; main.go:63 `"cap on rendered realms; 0 for no cap"`
